//: Electron main + preload, now fully converted to TypeScript. Compiles to
desktop/dist/*.js — Electron's main process is loaded via plain Node
require(), not ts-node/tsx, so something must compile these .ts files
before `electron .` can load them. Root package.json's `desktop-build`
script (tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.build.json) does this, run before
electron-dev/electron-build, the same way server/ already compiles to
This config (noEmit:true) is used by the `typecheck` script only —
tsconfig.build.json extends it and flips noEmit:false plus sets rootDir
and outDir for the actual build. See server/tsconfig.build.json for the
same split rationale (there it's about excluding tests/ from dist; here
there is no test suite to exclude, but the noEmit-vs-emit split is kept
main.ts holds the Prisma engine path resolution, the Windows
`file:C:/path` DATABASE_URL format, and asar path joins — none of which
are covered by tests. Every __dirname-relative path in main.ts and
server-wrapper.ts was re-audited (and where necessary given an extra
'..') for the additional desktop/dist/ nesting level this build step
introduces. See the NOTE comments beside each adjusted path.
